source: The existing SU2 open-box Hamiltonian family with the actual ground density constructed in anchored-casimir.v1; no surrogate, spin cutoff or quotient-metric replacement.

regime.energy: kappa>0 fixed in declared source units for volume comparisons
regime.volume: All finite open cubic boxes; the existing two-plaquette fixture is also covered by the same incidence bounds.

geometric_constructor.metric: The left Lie generators e_a/2 are orthonormal. Bracket structure constants are epsilon_abc; each SU2 factor has sectional curvature1/4 and Ricci1/2. Product Ricci remains1/2.
geometric_constructor.Hessian_component: |Hess_(ea,fb) Phi_A|<=sum_pi j_e*j_f*d_pi*||Phihat_A(pi)||_trace, including equal-edge symmetrized covariant derivatives.
geometric_constructor.row_bound: For n=|A|, the absolute Hessian row sum is <=3*(n+1)*W(Phi_A)/2.
geometric_constructor.weighted_curvature: Ric-Hess log rho >=(1/2-4096*r)*metric >5*metric/64 in the admitted regime.
geometric_constructor.functional_inequality: Bochner identity and weighted semigroup dissipation give Var_nu f <=(64/5)*integral |grad f|^2 dnu, first smooth then on H1. No tensorization theorem is presumed.

physical_detector.definition: D_Omega psi=Omega grad(psi/Omega), in the previously constructed covariant horizontal target.
physical_detector.uniform_constant: ||D_Omega psi||^2 >=(5/64)*||(I-P_Omega)psi||^2, uniformly over finite boxes and all physical form vectors in this regime.
physical_detector.finite_source_gap: Delta>=5*kappa/64, with sharper source bound kappa*(1/2-4096*r).
physical_detector.quotient_policy: Prove curvature on the smooth full product group and restrict to invariant functions; do not assume a smooth free orbit quotient.

limits.continuum: No thermodynamic correlation state, simultaneous continuum limit, target reconstruction or completion transfer is constructed.
limits.weak_coupling: Under the previously declared convention kappa=g^2/(2a), lambda=2/(a*g^2), r=4/g^4; this theorem requires g^4>1048576/27 and does not cover g->0.
limits.units: A volume-uniform bare/source gap is not a physical-unit continuum gap. Along refinement the physical conversion times kappa must be controlled independently.
limits.review: Written analytic theorem importing compact-group geometry and elliptic/Bochner facts, with exact regression controls; not a proof-assistant or independent target-review certificate.

gate_disposition: faithful-excitation-detection constructed at the stated uniform finite-source regime; uniform-energy-cost in fixed physical units, continuum correlations, reconstruction and completion remain open.
